resources.title: Northfield Retail Project 1: Investigating a Customer Churn Dashboard Request, Start to Finish Infographic
resources.description: The full data-analyst project lifecycle walked through a real business scenario: Northfield Retail wants to know why customers are churning. Covers the 7-step lifecycle (stakeholder meeting, define requirements, collect & prepare data, analyze, build visualizations, deliver insights, handoff & next steps), the high-level project flow from raw data sources through SQL/Excel/Python prep into Power BI/Tableau visuals and a final recommendation, the key deliverables, the tools used, and the actual business outcome (14% lower churn, 8% more repeat purchases, $325K revenue retained).

resources.title: Northfield Retail Project 2: Preparing and Analyzing Customer Data Infographic
resources.description: The data-preparation phase of the Northfield Retail churn project: identifying real data sources (sales, customer, orders & returns, store, marketing), extracting and joining data with T-SQL, cleaning and standardizing it with Excel/Power Query, an optional Python pass for deeper analysis, a table of common data-quality problems and how each one was actually fixed (missing values, duplicates, inconsistent dates, multiple sources, defining what 'churned' even means), and the exploratory-analysis results that set up the dashboards in Project 3.

resources.title: Northfield Retail Project 3: Building Customer Churn Dashboards in Power BI & Tableau Infographic
resources.description: Turning the cleaned churn analysis into real, interactive dashboards: the star-schema data model (FactCustomer surrounded by DimDate/DimCustomer/DimStore/DimProduct), the dashboard plan, a full Power BI churn-analysis dashboard example (KPI cards, trend chart, segment donut), the equivalent Tableau dashboard (churn by region map, churn by reason, churn by store type, top at-risk segments), the key interactive features built into both, and the resulting business insights and recommendations.

resources.title: Northfield Retail Project 4: Presenting Insights, Automation & Handoff Infographic
resources.description: The final phase of the Northfield Retail project: presenting a data-backed story to business leaders, a key-findings-to-recommendations table (why customers churn and what to actually do about it), automating ongoing operations with Azure Data Factory refreshes, Power BI/dataset updates, and Power Automate customer outreach, the full list of project deliverables and expected business impact (32% fewer customers churning, +$325K revenue retained, +8% repeat purchases), the skills demonstrated end to end, and every tool used across the whole project (T-SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python, Excel, Azure Data Factory, Power Automate, Git/GitHub).
